lines.2: A corner of the city skyline.
lines.3: One of the buildings owned by the Kiriya Company.
lines.4: The Princess had made herself completely at home in her private suite, with me waiting on her.
lines.5: A commercial for the company happened to be playing on TV.
lines.6: 「Otome says she'll serve as my bodyguard.」
lines.7: 「Oh, she finally made up her mind.」
lines.8: 「Everyone in the business world was jealous. The Kurogane family's prowess as bodyguards is legendary, after all.」
lines.9: 「And Yoppi will keep supporting me as my secretary.」
lines.10: 「Coming to Ryuumeikan was worth it... I found friends I can truly trust.」
lines.11: 「Now even when I reach the top, loneliness won't crush me.」
lines.13: 「Hehe... If you're going to be my attendant, Leo, you'd better build a body capable of protecting me and acquire at least a decent education.」
lines.15: 「Good. I'm counting on you a little, then.」
lines.18: Before the spectacular night view, the Princess smiled fearlessly.
lines.19: She apparently enjoyed looking down on the city lights.
lines.20: 「All right! Time to take on the world at its own money game.」
lines.22: 「First I'll eliminate every relative standing between me and the succession... Well, they'll make their moves too, but I'll crush them when they do!」
lines.23: 「I admire how calmly you can talk about eliminating your own family.」
lines.25: 「But if they get in my way, I'll crush them.」
lines.26: 「Then I'll take the entire Kiriya Company for myself!」
lines.28: 「And with the company, I'll conquer the market!」
lines.29: 「The wealth and fame of the world...」
lines.30: 「I'll seize them with my own two hands!」
lines.31: If you're lucky enough to be born human, you ought to test the limits of what you can achieve.
lines.32: With a sword of desire held in your heart.
lines.33: Striving for the very top, even if you have to trample others beneath you.
lines.34: I'm only the aide who'll support her in that.
lines.35: But if that's my role, I'll give it everything I have.
lines.36: Because I believe there's no limit to how high she can climb.
lines.37: Tutorial 6 is now available to play.
